CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 11
   C. 25
   D. 24

2. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 19
   C. 17
   D. 23

4. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 90

5. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 4
   C. 32
   D. 33

   D. 9

   A. 7

   D. 14

   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

9. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 5

10. Solve for x: x + 3 = 8. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 5
   C. 8
   D. 6

11. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 24
   C. 2
   D. 10

12. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 40
   C. 13
   D. 41

13. Solve for x: x + 7 = 19. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 12
   C. 19
   D. 7

14. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

15. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

16. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2, 4, 6
   B. 3, 6, 9
   C. 1, 2, 3, 6
   D. 1, 6

17. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 33

18. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 7
   C. 1
   D. 7

19. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 12

20. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 56
   C. 1
   D. 57

21. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

22. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

23. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 7
   C. 13
   D. 12

24. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 0
   C. 8
   D. 16
